item.title: Rallying Cry – August 9, 2026
item.description: A Costa Rican diplomat could make history as the first female UN chief, while a small Spanish village gets its moment in the spotlight as NASA’s eclipse hotspot, and a determined man drives 1,700 miles to save a rare Scottish phone box.
